meta.description: Frames Bayesian phylogenetics as approximating a posterior distribution over trees conditioned on data AND priors via an MCMC that must be proven to have converged, using MrBayes, BEAST2, RevBayes, and PhyloBayes-MPI.
meta.executed: 8/9 inputs executed (MrBayes 3.2.7a Windows, R rwty 1.0.3, Python example); Input 6 is a routing answer. PhyloBayes-MPI, BEAST2, RevBayes not executed.
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). The Skill's MrBayes block used with its seeds and stoprule=no; ngen scaled from 10,000,000 to 100k-300k. Input 5's data-run tree lengths come from the pre-fix gammadir/exp10 runs (commands unchanged); its new prior-only runs were executed. SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: All ESS, PSRF, posterior and marginal-likelihood values come from MrBayes runs on synthetic data.

methodological_ground.detail: No unconverged posterior reported, HME refused for model choice, stepping-stone used, near-zero internode reported as a soft node.

code_usability.detail: The fixed MrBayes block, 'mcmc append=yes ngen=<new total>', 'mcmc data=no', the ss line, the RWTY burnin expression and the example script all run.

functional_suitability.note: stoprule, append, prior-only, ss samples-per-step, RWTY burnin, seeds and polytomy-prior statements verified. Completeness 3/4: BEAST2 and RevBayes remain names only.

reliability.note: New Common Errors rows (early halt, HME banner) are accurate; the example silently runs its synthetic self-test when given one .p file (Input 9).

agent_usability.note: Convergence checklist and new append instruction are clear; nst=mixed output (model probabilities) is not explained.

security.note: Nothing sensitive; example lacks header validation.

maintainability.note: Self-testing example now documents its intended FAIL; no test NEXUS shipped.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing; seeds now in the block.

recommendations.title: Make the example refuse a single .p file
recommendations.problem: bayesian_convergence.py with one argument silently runs its synthetic self-test and exits 0.
recommendations.root_cause: Argument handling treats anything but two files as self-test mode.
recommendations.fix: Run the self-test only with --selftest; exit with a message when one file is given.

recommendations.title: Explain nst=mixed output
recommendations.problem: The Skill recommends nst=mixed but not how to read the model-probability table.
recommendations.root_cause: Model averaging is mentioned in one line.
recommendations.fix: Say sump prints gtrsubmodel posterior probabilities (mixed.mstat) and to report the spread, not one model.
